visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a close-up of a black iPhone SE3 screen displaying 3:41, then cuts to a young woman with long dark hair and a yellow top at a white desk. She smiles brightly and enthusiastically opens her gray laptop in a well-lit office environment with anime figurines and equipment visible. (2) A close-up of a blue iPhone 12 screen showing 3:43 appears, followed by a shot of the woman resting her chin on her hand while looking at her laptop with a bored, weary expression. (3) The sequence continues with a close-up of an iPhone 13 Pro Max, then shows the woman talking on a phone with a lanyard while typing on her laptop, appearing increasingly busy and stressed. (4) An iPhone 17 Pro Max screen is displayed, and the woman is then shown rapidly flipping through a stack of white papers with a frustrated and annoyed look on her face. (5) Finally, a fictional iPhone 30 screen is shown, and the woman is seen slamming a huge stack of papers onto her desk and burying her face in them, signifying total burnout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy, bright electronic pop track begins with a fast BPM and crisp synthesizer leads. The atmosphere is optimistic and light. (2) The music abruptly cuts to a slower, more casual and repetitive beat as the visual scene shifts, reflecting a change in mood to something more routine. (3) The track shifts again to a more intense, rhythmic electronic segment with stronger percussion, paralleling the character's busier work state. (4) The music becomes frantic and high-tempo, matching the rapid flipping of papers. (5) The music stops suddenly, followed by a sharp percussive 'thud' sound as papers hit the desk, then a short comedic digital stinger sound, followed by near-total silence.
